propositions: A new project-owned code-review criterion must define four distinct phase contracts: Pass 1 discovers grounded findings only without assessment; Pass 2 verifies atomic binary validity/impact questions only; Pass 3 applies deterministic thresholds without LLM; Pass 4 offers non-prescriptive guidance only.

The criterion implementation must emit grounded evidence findings without severity, confidence, or suggested_fix fields, and must abstain when phase ownership is unclear or only documentation/negative examples are changed.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..F6 must fire, RP-N1..N6 must not fire) must achieve recall 1.0, false-accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, per-case stability ≥2/3, and Cohen kappa ≥0.70 across three live calibration runs.
The criterion must be routed with exec: 1-TURN, block_threshold 0.90, and blocking_enabled false; routing is advisory during pilot and cannot block current review flows.

Implementation must be restricted to six project-owned files (.rebar prompt/routing/eval, tests/unit test, .gitignore exceptions, docs/llm-framework.md section) with no changes to core kernel or generic seams.
Live semantic calibration must record model identifier, UTC timestamp, all 36 case executions across three runs, and perfect metric achievement before landing.
